Priest of Light Torian:
Look around! You can see everything from many miles. And it's immediately obvious why they call this place Snowy Volcano.
Snowy cliffs right next to rivers of lava... I would've never believed it if I wasn't looking at it with my own two eyes.
This place used to be a cold desert, but recently flows of lava have come to surface and new monsters followed suit.
We still don't know why that happened. We must get to the bottom of it.
